rounds.text: Natura Hue Chem Ltd trades at an attractive price-to-book ratio of just 1.28x on a book value of ₹ 23.0 [E1], which is notably lower than the sector benchmark P/B of 4.35x [E6]. This valuation provides a conservative asset-backed foundation for a micro-cap company with a market capitalisation of ₹ 12.2 Cr [E2]. Furthermore, market participants have recognised underlying momentum, driving compounded share price growth of 188% over 1 year, 92% over 3 years, and 96% over 5 years [E15, E16, E17]. Conceded: [E7], [E8], [E13], [E14], [E43], and [E55].
